title: VPC & On‑Prem Initiative Runway and Cross‑Team Commitment Agreements
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: establish a clear quarterly runway and formal cross-team commitment agreements for Private (VPC + on-prem) features so engineering, infra, security, and solutions teams can execute to OKRs with predictable release windows and validated acceptance criteria.

Scope: align initiative-level milestones for: private control plane hardening, tenancy isolation rollout, encrypted KMS/HSM integration, upgrade/runbook for on-prem appliances, and Dedicated->Private migration paths. Produce sprint templates, stakeholder RACI, canary cohort definitions, and a release gating checklist.

Deliverables: PRD summary, sprint-by-sprint runway workbook, cross-team SLAs and commitment conformance sheet, acceptance test harness (smoke + upgrade + perf), pilot customer list and rollback plan, and a launch communication plan for Sales/Success.
acceptance_criteria: Core private control-plane GA checklist completed and validated in staging
KMS integration end-to-end demo with two customer KMS providers and automated key rotation verified
Upgrade runbook executed successfully on a pilot on-prem tenant with zero data loss and documented downtime
Performance baseline: 95th percentile tail latency <= 1.8x hosted baseline under pilot workload for gen/text endpoints
Canary cohort defined (3 pilot customers) and rollback procedure proven in <30 minutes

success_metrics: Onboard 3 pilot customers to private instances by end of Q2
Achieve <2x hosted latency for 95th percentile under pilot workloads
Reduction in private feature rollout time from 10 weeks to 6 weeks via runbook and templates
<1 severity-2 incident per quarter for pilot cohort after GA
risks: KMS/HSM integration delay: mitigations - narrow initial provider support and prioritize adapter interfaces
Customer upgrade failures: mitigations - staged canaries, automated rollback scripts, and mandatory dry-run windows
Resource contention with Dedicated capacity work: mitigations - reserve 'private runway' capacity for sprint-critical tasks and negotiate cross-team SLAs
Compliance changes mid-quarter: mitigations - track regulatory blockers and have contingency sprint slots
